mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month acceleration in real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2% signals stronger corporate earnings momentum, which raises equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters where GDPC1 > 2% for 6 months, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and ultimately reduces profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4% for 3 months, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 0% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 0% for 2 months, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 0% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS < 0% for 3 months, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6% signals labor market slack, which reduces wage pressures and increases profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 6% for 3 months, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 1,000,000 units signals weakening housing demand, which reduces construction-related corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1,000,000 for 2 months, the hypothesis is rejected.
